youtube_title_en: 800 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Joining a Language Exchange
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「參加英語角」情境對話，共 800 句、400 組短句（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。從進門拿名牌、兩個人一組坐下來，到你說中文我說英文、請對方慢一點、問這個字怎麼念、玩字卡配對、交換電話號碼，最後約下週聊旅遊，八個場景一路聽下去。每句 3 到 9 個字，A2 生活口語，不用背、不用看螢幕，躺下來循環聽 800 句就能記住。適合英語初學者、ESL 學員、想睡前複習英文的大人。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features 800 practical Joining a Language Exchange phrases in 400 pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). Eight scenes run in order: grabbing a name tag at the door, sitting down in pairs, speaking Chinese for English, asking someone to slow down, asking how a word sounds, playing the flashcard matching game, swapping phone numbers, and setting up next week's travel topic. Every line is 3 to 9 words at CEFR A2 level, so you just lie down and let the 800-sentence loop do the work. Great for beginners, ESL learners, and anyone reviewing English before bed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the English corner open today?
dialogue.zh: 英語角今天開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the door opened ten minutes ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə dɔr ˈoʊpənd tɛn ˈmɪnɪts əˈɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 開著，門十分鐘前就打開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sign in at this table, correct?
dialogue.zh: 在這裡的桌子簽到，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, write your name on this list.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, raɪt jɔr neɪm ɑn ðɪs lɪst./
dialogue.zh: 可以，把名字寫在這張名單上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My name goes on this tag, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ neɪm ɡoʊz ɑn ðɪs tæɡ, raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我的名字寫在這張名牌上，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, every guest gets one tag here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈɛvri ɡɛst ɡɛts wʌn tæɡ hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 對，每位來賓都在這裡領一張名牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This tag is for people new here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs tæɡ ɪz fɚ ˈpipəl nu hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 這張名牌是給新來的人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, stick it on your coat pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, stɪk ɪt ɑn jɔr koʊt ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 對，把它貼在你外套口袋上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do the name tags go?
dialogue.zh: 名牌要放在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the small table near the tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə smɔl ˈteɪbəl nɪr ðə ti./
dialogue.zh: 放茶壺旁邊那張小桌子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need tape for this tag?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid teɪp fɔr ðɪs tæɡ?/
dialogue.zh: 這個名牌還要另外用膠帶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the back is already sticky.
dialogue.zh: 不用，背面已經有膠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How often do you come here?
dialogue.zh: 你多久來這裡一次？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Since March, so about ten times.
dialogue.zh: 從三月開始，大約來了十次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who runs the corner tonight?
dialogue.zh: 今晚誰在主持英語角？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our host Linda, she is at the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊr hoʊst ˈlɪndə, ʃi ɪz æt ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 是我們的主持人琳達，她在門口接待。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the room free right now?
dialogue.zh: 現在房間裡還有空位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two seats are open by the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu sits ɑr ˈoʊpən baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 靠窗那邊還空著兩個位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bag stays under this chair?
dialogue.zh: 我的包包放這張椅子下好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but keep your phone with you.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, bʌt kip jɔr foʊn wɪð ju./
dialogue.zh: 可以，不過手機要隨身帶著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time does the first round start?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt taɪm dʌz ðə fɜrst raʊnd stɑrt?/
dialogue.zh: 第一輪活動幾點開始？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It starts when ten people are here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stɑrts wɛn tɛn ˈpipəl ɑr hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 等這裡滿十個人就開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I the only new person here?
dialogue.phonetic: /æm aɪ ði ˈoʊnli nu ˈpɜrsən hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 我是不是場中唯一的新面孔？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, four other new faces came tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, fɔr ˈʌðər nu ˈfeɪsəz keɪm təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 不是，今晚還有另外四張新面孔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Booking needed for tonight?
dialogue.zh: 今晚要先報名嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never, just walk in any Tuesday.
dialogue.zh: 不用，週二直接走進來就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is the door fee?
dialogue.zh: 進門的費用是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing, but tea costs five yuan.
dialogue.zh: 不收費，只是茶要五塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tea at that table is free?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ti æt ðæt ˈteɪbəl ɪz fri?/
dialogue.zh: 那桌的茶是免費的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but ask before you pour.
dialogue.zh: 是，不過倒茶之前先問一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I sit tonight?
dialogue.zh: 我今晚該坐哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit with me, that chair is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt wɪð mi, ðæt tʃɛr ɪz fri./
dialogue.zh: 坐我這邊吧，那個位子沒人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seats move during the night, yes?
dialogue.zh: 今晚座位會換，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we change partners after each game.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wi tʃeɪndʒ ˈpɑrtənɚz ˈæftər itʃ ɡeɪm./
dialogue.zh: 會，每一輪遊戲結束後就換搭檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this seat saved for anyone?
dialogue.zh: 這個位子幫誰留的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, my partner stayed home tonight.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我的搭檔今晚留在家裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is on this little card?
dialogue.zh: 這張小卡片上寫的是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A topic list, we pick one later.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtɑpɪk lɪst, wi pɪk wʌn ˈleɪtɚ./
dialogue.zh: 是話題清單，等一下會挑一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I get the right room number?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd aɪ ɡɛt ðə raɪt rum ˈnʌmbɚ?/
dialogue.zh: 我房間號碼沒記錯吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, second floor, this is our place.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈsɛkənd flɔr, ðɪs ɪz ˈaʊr pleɪs./
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，二樓，我們就在這個地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have extra tags for friends?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ˈɛkstrə tæɡz fɔr frɛndz?/
dialogue.zh: 你們還有多的名牌給朋友嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the host box, it has many.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðə hoʊst bɑks, ɪt hæz ˈmɛni./
dialogue.zh: 去主持人那個盒子找，裡面很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should my name be big or small?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd maɪ neɪm bi bɪɡ ɔr smɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 我的名字要寫大一點還是小一點？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write it large so all can read.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ɪt lɑrdʒ soʊ ɔl kæn rid./
dialogue.zh: 寫大一些，別人才看得清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that your pen, or may I use it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt jɔr pɛn, ɔr meɪ aɪ juz ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 那枝筆是你的嗎，我可以用一下？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, go ahead and write your tag.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ɡoʊ əˈhɛd ænd raɪt jɔr tæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 不用，你直接拿去寫你的名牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is everyone wearing a green tag?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz ˈɛvriwʌn ˈwɛrɪŋ ə ɡrin tæɡ?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼大家戴的都是綠色名牌？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Green marks the people who host.
dialogue.zh: 綠色標示的是幫忙主持的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my tag say Chinese first?
dialogue.zh: 我的名牌可以改成先講中文嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Red does, the blues speak English.
dialogue.zh: 紅色那張就是，拿藍色名牌的講英文。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does one corner night last?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ dʌz wʌn ˈkɔrnər naɪt læst?/
dialogue.zh: 一晚英語角會進行多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ninety minutes, with one short break.
dialogue.zh: 九十分鐘，中間休息一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I return this name tag?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ rɪˈtɜrn ðɪs neɪm tæɡ?/
dialogue.zh: 這個名牌散場時要還到哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back into the jar on the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk ˈɪntu ðə dʒɑr ɑn ðə dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 丟回桌上的那個罐子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it okay to keep the tag?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt oʊˈkeɪ tu kip ðə tæɡ?/
dialogue.zh: 這張名牌可以留下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, take it home as a memory.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, teɪk ɪt hoʊm æz ə ˈmɛməri./
dialogue.zh: 可以，帶回家當個紀念。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need a partner before we sit?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi nid ə ˈpɑrtənɚ bɪˈfɔr wi sɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 坐下之前一定要先找好搭檔嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the host pairs us at eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðə hoʊst pɛrz ʌs æt eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 不用，八點時主持人會幫我們配對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some water without asking?
dialogue.zh: 可以自己倒水喝嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The jug sits beside the coat rack.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dʒʌɡ sɪts bəˈsaɪd ðə koʊt ræk./
dialogue.zh: 水壺就擱在衣帽架旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I early for the corner?
dialogue.zh: 我是不是來得太早了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, six people are already inside.
dialogue.zh: 不早，裡面已經有六個人了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which marker writes on paper tags?
dialogue.zh: 哪一枝筆適合寫紙製名牌？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one, it dries in seconds.
dialogue.zh: 這枝，幾秒鐘就乾了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I copy this list later?
dialogue.zh: 我晚一點可以抄這張名單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, the sheet stays on this desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, ðə ʃit steɪz ɑn ðɪs dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 當然，那張表會留在這張桌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I have to speak English at the door?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ hæv tu spik ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ æt ðə dɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 我一進門就要開始說英文嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, Chinese is fine while you wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ˌtʃaɪˈniz ɪz faɪn waɪl ju weɪt./
dialogue.zh: 不用，等候的時候講中文也可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does the host keep the tags?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dʌz ðə hoʊst kip ðə tæɡz?/
dialogue.zh: 主持人把名牌放在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In that red basket under the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðæt rɛd ˈbæskət ˈʌndər ðə ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 在桌子下面那個紅色籃子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write my Chinese name here?
dialogue.zh: 幫我在這裡寫中文名字好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, say it slow and I will try.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, seɪ ɪt sloʊ ænd aɪ wɪl traɪ./
dialogue.zh: 好，你慢慢說，我試著寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a nickname okay on the tag?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ə ˈnɪkneɪm oʊˈkeɪ ɑn ðə tæɡ?/
dialogue.zh: 名牌上可以只寫綽號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Many use one, it starts talk faster.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛni juz wʌn, ɪt stɑrts tɔk ˈfæstɚ./
dialogue.zh: 很多人都這樣，聊天會比較快開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is there a tag on my chair?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz ðɛr ə tæɡ ɑn maɪ tʃɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼我的椅子上放了一張名牌？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The host puts one on each chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hoʊst pʊts wʌn ɑn itʃ tʃɛr./
dialogue.zh: 主持人每張椅子都放了一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I stick the tag on my sleeve?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ stɪk ðə tæɡ ɑn maɪ sliv?/
dialogue.zh: 我要把名牌貼在袖子上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chest is best, so faces match names.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛst ɪz bɛst, soʊ ˈfeɪsəz mætʃ neɪmz./
dialogue.zh: 貼在胸口最好，臉才對得上名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I sit near the heater first?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ sɪt nɪr ði ˈhitɚ fɜrst?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以先坐在暖氣旁邊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, that chair is still open.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv kɔrs, ðæt tʃɛr ɪz stɪl ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 當然，那個座位還空著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the corner change its room?
dialogue.zh: 英語角換過房間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we moved up one floor.
dialogue.zh: 有，我們往上搬了一樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the list only for new people?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə lɪst ˈoʊnli fɔr nu ˈpipəl?/
dialogue.zh: 那張名單只給新來的人填嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Regulars sign too, so join the line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛɡjəlɚz saɪn tu, soʊ dʒɔɪn ðə laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 舊面孔也會簽，所以先排隊吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my cousin join the corner?
dialogue.zh: 我表姐可以來參加英語角嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tell her to grab a tag.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, tɛl hɚ tu ɡræb ə tæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 可以，叫她自己先拿一張名牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do the numbers on tags mean?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt du ðə ˈnʌmbərz ɑn tæɡz min?/
dialogue.zh: 名牌上的數字是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They count nights here, mine says nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ kaʊnt naɪts hɪr, maɪn sɛz naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 是來過的晚數，我那張寫著九。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to return the marker?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu rɪˈtɜrn ðə ˈmɑrkɚ?/
dialogue.zh: 這枝筆我需要還給你嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, leave it for the next guest.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, liv ɪt fɔr ðə nɛkst ɡɛst./
dialogue.zh: 不用，留著給下一位來賓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is tonight your first time here?
dialogue.zh: 今晚是你第一次來這裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I skipped two weeks, I am back.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, aɪ skɪpt tu wikz, aɪ æm bæk./
dialogue.zh: 不是，我斷了兩週，今天回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I put my wet coat?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr kæn aɪ pʊt maɪ wɛt koʊt?/
dialogue.zh: 我濕透的外套可以放哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rack stands left of the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ræk stændz lɛft əv ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 衣架就立在門口左手邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we say our names out loud?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi seɪ ˈaʊr neɪmz aʊt laʊd?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要把自己的名字大聲說出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one line each, then the game starts.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wʌn laɪn itʃ, ðɛn ðə ɡeɪm stɑrts./
dialogue.zh: 對，一人一句，然後就開始遊戲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I keep my bag on my lap?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ kip maɪ bæɡ ɑn maɪ læp?/
dialogue.zh: 我的包包可以放在腿上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, the room has hooks for bags.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn, ðə rum hæz hʊks fɔr bæɡz./
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，房間裡有掛包包的勾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does everyone have a tag now?
dialogue.zh: 現在每一個人都有名牌了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, so follow me to the tables.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, soʊ ˈfɑloʊ mi tu ðə ˈteɪbəlz./
dialogue.zh: 都有了，那跟我走到桌子那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two chairs facing each other?
dialogue.zh: 是兩張椅子面對面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one pair sits facing the other.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wʌn pɛr sɪts ˈfeɪsɪŋ ði ˈʌðɚ./
dialogue.zh: 對，兩人一組面對面坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How does the host pick our seats?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ dʌz ðə hoʊst pɪk ˈaʊr sits?/
dialogue.zh: 主持人怎麼幫我們選座位？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They count tags and match the colors.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ kaʊnt tæɡz ænd mætʃ ðə ˈkʌlɚz./
dialogue.zh: 他們數名牌，再照顏色配成對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This chair for me or the next pair?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs tʃɛr fɔr mi ɔr ðə nɛkst pɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 這張椅子給我的，還是下一組？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yours, sit down and wait one minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔrz, sɪt daʊn ænd weɪt wʌn ˈmɪnɪt./
dialogue.zh: 是你的，坐下來等一分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you my partner right now?
dialogue.zh: 你現在就是我的搭檔嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Looks like it, I am Kevin.
dialogue.zh: 看起來是的，我是凱文。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Across or side by side?
dialogue.zh: 面對面坐，還是並排坐？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Across, so you can see my face.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈkrɔs, soʊ ju kæn si maɪ feɪs./
dialogue.zh: 對面坐，這樣你看得到我的臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if my partner has not come?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf maɪ ˈpɑrtənɚ hæz nɑt kʌm?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我的搭檔還沒來呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait two minutes, then join my table.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt tu ˈmɪnɪts, ðɛn dʒɔɪn maɪ ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 等兩分鐘，然後過來我這桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Swap seats with that pair?
dialogue.zh: 跟那一組換位子好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, ask them when the bell rings.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, æsk ðɛm wɛn ðə bɛl rɪŋz./
dialogue.zh: 可以，等鐘響時去問他們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do pairs change after every game?
dialogue.zh: 每一場遊戲之後都換搭檔嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always, that is the rule here.
dialogue.zh: 一定換，這是這裡的規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One table has three of us.
dialogue.zh: 這一桌擠了三個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will move, my partner waits over there.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl muv, maɪ ˈpɑrtənɚ weɪts ˈoʊvɚ ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 我換過去，我的搭檔在那邊等我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it rude to ask a name again?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt rud tu æsk ə neɪm əˈɡɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 名字再問一次會沒禮貌嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never, we forget names every week.
dialogue.zh: 不會，我們每週都記不住名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do we start with a stranger?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du wi stɑrt wɪð ə ˈstreɪndʒɚ?/
dialogue.zh: 跟不熟的人要怎麼開始聊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask one question about their tag.
dialogue.zh: 先問一個關於對方名牌的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who holds the topic card first?
dialogue.zh: 誰先拿著話題卡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You do, you drew this card first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju du, ju dru ðɪs kɑrd fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 你拿，是你先抽到這張卡的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The floor cushions are open too?
dialogue.zh: 地板上的坐墊也能坐嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, take the pair by the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, teɪk ðə pɛr baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 可以，拿窗邊那一對坐墊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did that pair already finish their round?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðæt pɛr ɔlˈrɛdi ˈfɪnɪʃ ðɛr raʊnd?/
dialogue.zh: 那一組已經講完一輪了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the bell says start again.
dialogue.zh: 是的，鐘聲說要重新開始了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I face you, or the door?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ feɪs ju, ɔr ðə dɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 我是要面對你，還是面對門？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Face me, the door is behind me.
dialogue.phonetic: /feɪs mi, ðə dɔr ɪz bɪˈhaɪnd mi./
dialogue.zh: 面對我，門在我後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How near should two partners sit?
dialogue.zh: 兩個搭檔要坐多近？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close enough to share one card.
dialogue.zh: 近到能一起看一張卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I move to the quiet corner?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ muv tu ðə ˈkwaɪət ˈkɔrnər?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以坐到安靜的那個角落嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, two seats sit empty there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ əˈhɛd, tu sits sɪt ˈɛmpti ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 請便，那邊還空著兩個位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your partner late again tonight?
dialogue.zh: 你的夥伴今晚又遲到了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, his tag hangs on the hook.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, hɪz tæɡ hæŋz ɑn ðə hʊk./
dialogue.zh: 是啊，他的名牌還掛在勾子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three of us in one pair?
dialogue.zh: 我們三個人算一組嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, one of you waits a round.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, wʌn əv ju weɪts ə raʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 不行，你們其中一人先等一輪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tag color picks the partner?
dialogue.zh: 是名牌顏色決定夥伴嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most do, blue sits with red.
dialogue.zh: 多數人這樣，藍色配紅色坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why did she move her chair here?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ dɪd ʃi muv hɚ tʃɛr hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 她為什麼把椅子搬到這裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her partner left, so she joins us.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɚ ˈpɑrtənɚ lɛft, soʊ ʃi dʒɔɪnz ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 她的搭檔走了，所以她加入我們這一組。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I ask you to sit down?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ æsk ju tu sɪt daʊn?/
dialogue.zh: 我該請你坐下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, you already took the free chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ju ɔlˈrɛdi tʊk ðə fri tʃɛr./
dialogue.zh: 不用，你已經坐到那個空位了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we two pairs, or one group?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr wi tu pɛrz, ɔr wʌn ɡrup?/
dialogue.zh: 我們是兩個二人組，還是一群人？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two pairs, and we take turns talking.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu pɛrz, ænd wi teɪk tɜrnz ˈtɔkɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 兩個二人組，然後輪流說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who sits with the new person then?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu sɪts wɪð ðə nu ˈpɜrsən ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 那誰來陪剛來的那位？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will, my tag is green today.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl, maɪ tæɡ ɪz ɡrin təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我陪，我今天戴綠色名牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I keep this seat till the bell?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ kip ðɪs sit tɪl ðə bɛl?/
dialogue.zh: 這個位子我可以坐到鐘響嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, take it, I will wait here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, teɪk ɪt, aɪ wɪl weɪt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 可以，你坐，我在這裡等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Partners face the host as well?
dialogue.zh: 夥伴也要面向主持嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only at the start, then each other.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli æt ðə stɑrt, ðɛn itʃ ˈʌðɚ./
dialogue.zh: 只有一開始，之後就面對彼此。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I ask for this seat?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ æsk fɔr ðɪs sit?/
dialogue.zh: 這個位子我該怎麼開口要？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Point and say this seat is open.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɔɪnt ænd seɪ ðɪs sit ɪz ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 指一下，說這個位子還空著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same level in every pair?
dialogue.zh: 每一組的程度都一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We try, tags show your years of study.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi traɪ, tæɡz ʃoʊ jɔr jɪrz əv ˈstʌdi./
dialogue.zh: 我們會盡量，名牌顯示你學了幾年。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does a person go without a pair?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dʌz ə ˈpɜrsən ɡoʊ wɪˈðaʊt ə pɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 落單的人要走去哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: To the host line, they fix it fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ðə hoʊst laɪn, ðeɪ fɪks ɪt fæst./
dialogue.zh: 到主持人那排，他們很快就處理好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One pair for the whole night?
dialogue.zh: 同一組配對整晚嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the bell splits us twice.
dialogue.zh: 不行，鐘聲會把我們拆開兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your bag on the floor, okay?
dialogue.zh: 你的包包放地板上可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, push it under the seat.
dialogue.zh: 可以，把它推到座位下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the third chair for me?
dialogue.zh: 第三張椅子是給我的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, that one holds the timer.
dialogue.zh: 不是，那張椅子上放計時器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who sits beside the name list?
dialogue.zh: 誰坐在名單旁邊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The host, so she can check tags.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hoʊst, soʊ ʃi kæn tʃɛk tæɡz./
dialogue.zh: 主持人，方便她核對名牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Partners may share a single card?
dialogue.zh: 兩人可以共用一張字卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, that saves paper here.
dialogue.zh: 當然，這裡這樣能省紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we sit this way last week?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd wi sɪt ðɪs weɪ læst wik?/
dialogue.zh: 上週我們是這樣坐的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, last week I sat with Ann.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, læst wik aɪ sæt wɪð æn./
dialogue.zh: 不是，上週我坐在安旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I greet my partner first?
dialogue.zh: 我應該先跟搭檔打招呼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one sentence, then the card.
dialogue.zh: 對，一句話就好，然後看卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these two chairs one pair?
dialogue.zh: 這兩張椅子是一組的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, sit down, I will take the other.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, sɪt daʊn, aɪ wɪl teɪk ði ˈʌðɚ./
dialogue.zh: 是的，你坐，我坐另一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does one pair talk?
dialogue.zh: 一組要聊多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four minutes, then we rotate.
dialogue.zh: 四分鐘，然後我們輪轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rotate to the left or right?
dialogue.zh: 輪換是往左還是往右？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the door side moves first.
dialogue.zh: 往右，靠門那一排先移動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The loud pair takes one more?
dialogue.zh: 那一大聲的組還收人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, that table fits one more.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，那桌還多一個位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we talk across the whole room?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi tɔk əˈkrɔs ðə hoʊl rum?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要對著整個房間說話嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, a pair talks just to itself.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ə pɛr tɔks dʒʌst tu ɪtˈsɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 不用，一組只跟自己那人講。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it my turn to pick a card?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt maɪ tɜrn tu pɪk ə kɑrd?/
dialogue.zh: 輪到我選卡了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, choose any card from the top.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, tʃuz ˈɛni kɑrd frʌm ðə tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 對，從最上面任意抽一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I bring my chair closer?
dialogue.zh: 我可以把椅子挪近一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the floor is free over here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə flɔr ɪz fri ˈoʊvɚ hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 可以，這邊地板還有空間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is my partner after the break?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu ɪz maɪ ˈpɑrtənɚ ˈæftər ðə breɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 休息之後我的搭檔是誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask the host, she writes the plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ðə hoʊst, ʃi raɪts ðə plæn./
dialogue.zh: 問主持人，名單是她寫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we stay seated during the game?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi steɪ ˈsitɪd ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə ɡeɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 玩遊戲時要一直坐著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the game stands everyone up.
dialogue.zh: 不用，遊戲會讓全部人站起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that pair finished talking already?
dialogue.zh: 那一組已經講完了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they swapped seats two rounds ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðeɪ swæpt sits tu raʊndz əˈɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 是啊，兩輪前他們就換坐了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I sit with whoever is free?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ sɪt wɪð huˈɛvɚ ɪz fri?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以跟任何有空位的人坐嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, grab any empty chair now.
dialogue.zh: 可以，現在隨便拉一張空椅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does my tag say pair me up?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz maɪ tæɡ seɪ pɛr mi ʌp?/
dialogue.zh: 我的名牌上寫著要幫我配對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the host reads tags out loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðə hoʊst ridz tæɡz aʊt laʊd./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，主持人會把名牌大聲念出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I share my notes with you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ʃɛr maɪ noʊts wɪð ju?/
dialogue.zh: 我的筆記可以跟你共用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, pairs trade notes at the end.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, pɛrz treɪd noʊts æt ði ɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 可以，散組前大家會交換筆記。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we close our pair with a word?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi kloʊz ˈaʊr pɛr wɪð ə wɜrd?/
dialogue.zh: 我們這一組結束時要各說一句嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, each says one thing they liked.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, itʃ sɛz wʌn θɪŋ ðeɪ laɪkt./
dialogue.zh: 對，每人講一個剛才喜歡的說法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the language rule here?
dialogue.zh: 這裡的語言規則是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half English, half Chinese, by the bell.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ, hæf ˌtʃaɪˈniz, baɪ ðə bɛl./
dialogue.zh: 聽鐘聲，一半英文一半中文。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chinese for this round, right?
dialogue.zh: 這一輪說中文，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, this round belongs to English.
dialogue.zh: 不是，這一輪輪到說英文。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whose turn is it to talk first?
dialogue.phonetic: /huz tɜrn ɪz ɪt tu tɔk fɜrst?/
dialogue.zh: 先開口輪到誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yours, your tag sits on top.
dialogue.zh: 輪到你，你的名牌在最上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Answer in my own language first?
dialogue.zh: 先用自己的語言回答好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, then switch back to English.
dialogue.zh: 可以，然後再換回英文。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do we split the two languages?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du wi splɪt ðə tu ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒəz?/
dialogue.zh: 兩種語言時間怎麼分？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four minutes each, then we swap.
dialogue.zh: 各四分鐘，然後互換。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chinese allowed at this table?
dialogue.zh: 這一桌可以講中文嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only in the second half, I promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪn ðə ˈsɛkənd hæf, aɪ ˈprɑmɪs./
dialogue.zh: 只有後一半可以，我跟你保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You talk Chinese, I talk English?
dialogue.zh: 你講中文，我講英文，是這樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, your Chinese for my English.
dialogue.zh: 對，你用中文換我的英文。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I slip into Chinese?
dialogue.zh: 如果我不小心滑到中文怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Laugh, then say it again in English.
dialogue.phonetic: /læf, ðɛn seɪ ɪt əˈɡɛn ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ./
dialogue.zh: 笑一下，再用英文說一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I translate every word?
dialogue.zh: 每個字都要翻譯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, just the ones that stop you.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, dʒʌst ði wʌnz ðæt stɑp ju./
dialogue.zh: 不用，只翻那些卡住你的字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both of us learn something tonight?
dialogue.zh: 我們兩個今晚都會學到東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that is why we pair up.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðæt ɪz waɪ wi pɛr ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 當然，這就是我們要配對的原因。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say that once in Chinese?
dialogue.zh: 那句用中文說一次好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, and you repeat mine in English.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, ænd ju rɪˈpit maɪn ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ./
dialogue.zh: 可以，你再把我的那句用英文念一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which language is harder for you?
dialogue.zh: 對你來說哪種語言比較難？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chinese tones are harder for me.
dialogue.zh: 對我來說中文的四聲比較難。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Short English okay at this corner?
dialogue.zh: 在這裡講簡短英文沒問題吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, short lines teach better here.
dialogue.zh: 可以，短句子在這裡比較好學。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One small sound fix each round?
dialogue.zh: 每一輪只糾一個音嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one small fix at a time.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wʌn smɔl fɪks æt ə taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 對，一次只改一個小地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I hear your Chinese name?
dialogue.zh: 我可以聽一下你的中文名字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and tell me your English one.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ænd tɛl mi jɔr ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 好，也請告訴我你的英文名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who decides when we switch back?
dialogue.zh: 誰決定什麼時候換回來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bell, never your partner.
dialogue.zh: 是鐘聲，不是你的搭檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One mixed word in this round?
dialogue.zh: 這一輪可以混一個字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only names, everything else is English.
dialogue.zh: 只有名字可以，其他都要講英文。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My slow Chinese sounds clear?
dialogue.zh: 我慢慢的中文說得清楚嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly, the last part was lost.
dialogue.zh: 大概懂，最後那一段我沒聽見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I write the rule on my tag?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ raɪt ðə rul ɑn maɪ tæɡ?/
dialogue.zh: 我要把規則寫在名牌上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, put it on the back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪˈdiə, pʊt ɪt ɑn ðə bæk./
dialogue.zh: 好主意，寫在背面就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Silence part of the plan here?
dialogue.zh: 這裡的規矩允許安靜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, one person must always talk.
dialogue.zh: 不是，一定得有一個人一直說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What happens if we both pause?
dialogue.zh: 如果我們兩個都停下來會怎樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The host counts down from five.
dialogue.zh: 主持人會從五開始倒數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: English the whole night through?
dialogue.zh: 整晚都只講英文嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You will miss the Chinese half.
dialogue.zh: 那你就錯過中文那一半了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much Chinese do you want?
dialogue.zh: 你想聽多少中文？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enough to fix my tones tonight.
dialogue.zh: 夠我今晚把聲調改正就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Repeat after each other once?
dialogue.zh: 互相跟讀一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, once slow, then once fast.
dialogue.zh: 對，慢慢一次，然後快一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my turn over already?
dialogue.zh: 我這一輪已經結束了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, two minutes are still left.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，還剩兩分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Early swap, is that allowed?
dialogue.zh: 提早換夥伴可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, raise your card up high.
dialogue.zh: 可以，把手上的卡舉高。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which half is for listening?
dialogue.zh: 哪一半是專門拿來聽的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both halves, we trade every round.
dialogue.zh: 兩半都是，每一輪互換。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need perfect grammar now?
dialogue.zh: 我現在文法一定要完全正確嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never, the corner loves mistakes.
dialogue.zh: 才不會，英語角最歡迎錯誤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you stop me if I go wrong?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ju stɑp mi ɪf aɪ ɡoʊ rɔŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 我說錯了你會打斷我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only after you finish a sentence.
dialogue.zh: 只在你把句子說完之後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A slower round for this pair?
dialogue.zh: 我們這組慢一輪好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, take a longer minute each.
dialogue.zh: 可以，每人多拿一分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pairs teach more than a book?
dialogue.zh: 配對對話比課本學得多嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a book never answers back.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，書永遠不會回你話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is one language better at this table?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz wʌn ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ ˈbɛtɚ æt ðɪs ˈteɪbəl?/
dialogue.zh: 這一桌哪一種語言比較好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, both take their turns here.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，兩種在這裡輪流登場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I hold the topic card?
dialogue.zh: 我可以拿著那張話題卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, read it in Chinese first.
dialogue.zh: 可以，先用中文讀一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I copy your good words?
dialogue.zh: 你講得好的字我可以抄嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please, my notebook is right here.
dialogue.zh: 請抄，我的筆記本就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A quiet test between us tonight?
dialogue.zh: 今晚我們之間算小測驗嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only gently, nobody grades here.
dialogue.zh: 只有輕鬆地問，這裡不打分數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My family as a topic now?
dialogue.zh: 現在可以講我的家人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the card says talk about home.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə kɑrd sɛz tɔk əˈbaʊt hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 可以，那張卡就是請你聊家裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long till the language swap?
dialogue.zh: 還有多久要換語言？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One minute, then Chinese comes in.
dialogue.zh: 一分鐘，接著換中文上場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my English too hard tonight?
dialogue.zh: 我今晚的英文是不是太難了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is clear, keep going like that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz klɪr, kip ˈɡoʊɪŋ laɪk ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 很聽得懂，就這樣繼續說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say the Chinese part first?
dialogue.zh: 先把中文那段說出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, my ears need real practice.
dialogue.zh: 想，我的耳朵需要真的練習。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do we switch like this?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼要這樣交換語言？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So both leave with new words.
dialogue.zh: 這樣兩個人離場時才都有新字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which host speaks the best Chinese?
dialogue.zh: 哪位主持的中文講得最好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Linda does, her Chinese is smooth.
dialogue.zh: 琳達可以，她的中文很順。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I forget a Chinese word?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf aɪ fɚˈɡɛt ə ˌtʃaɪˈniz wɜrd?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我忘記中文怎麼說呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say it in English, we will guess.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ɪt ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ, wi wɪl ɡɛs./
dialogue.zh: 就用英文說，我們會猜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this round for questions?
dialogue.zh: 這一輪是專門問問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, ask three, I answer three.
dialogue.zh: 對，你問三個，我答三個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slower for this round, okay?
dialogue.zh: 這一輪慢一點好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I will wait for your turn.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, aɪ wɪl weɪt fɔr jɔr tɜrn./
dialogue.zh: 好啊，我會等你說完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A fresh topic card to choose?
dialogue.zh: 可以自由挑一張話題卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, take the card you like.
dialogue.zh: 可以，挑你喜歡的那張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I talk less in this round?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ tɔk lɛs ɪn ðɪs raʊnd?/
dialogue.zh: 這一輪我該少講一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Less, so I can learn something.
dialogue.zh: 少講一點，我才學得到東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it strange to teach a stranger?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt streɪndʒ tu titʃ ə ˈstreɪndʒɚ?/
dialogue.zh: 教一個不熟的人會不會很奇怪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, everyone here teaches someone.
dialogue.zh: 不會，這裡每個人都在教某個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we end the pair with thanks?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi ɛnd ðə pɛr wɪð θæŋks?/
dialogue.zh: 我們這一組最後要道謝嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, in the other language, always.
dialogue.zh: 對，而且一律用另一種語言說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I stay on English one more round?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ steɪ ɑn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ wʌn mɔr raʊnd?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以再多留一輪英文嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but let me hear Chinese next.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, bʌt lɛt mi hɪr ˌtʃaɪˈniz nɛkst./
dialogue.zh: 可以，不過下一輪換我講中文。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do both partners get the same time?
dialogue.phonetic: /du boʊθ ˈpɑrtənɚz ɡɛt ðə seɪm taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 兩個搭檔的時間一樣長嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the timer keeps us fair.
dialogue.zh: 一樣，計時器讓我們公平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A little slower, please.
dialogue.zh: 請再慢一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will break each sentence.
dialogue.zh: 可以，我把每個句子拆開說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You spoke so fast just now.
dialogue.zh: 你剛剛說得太快了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, the long story made me rush.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri, ðə lɔŋ ˈstɔri meɪd mi rʌʃ./
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，那個長故事讓我急著講。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say that again, but slowly.
dialogue.zh: 那一句再說一次，不過要慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, and I will pause twice.
dialogue.zh: 好，我會停兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I only caught two words there.
dialogue.zh: 那句話我只聽懂兩個字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which two, I will build around them.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ tu, aɪ wɪl bɪld əˈraʊnd ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 哪兩個？我用它們再組一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you repeat the last part?
dialogue.zh: 你可以重複最後那一段嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, the ending was too quick.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，結尾我說太快了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write this down on my card?
dialogue.zh: 這個要寫在我的卡上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, short words are easier to hear.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ʃɔrt wɜrdz ɑr ˈizɪɚ tu hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 對，短一點的字比較容易聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please use small words tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚請你用簡單的字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, no hard words from now.
dialogue.zh: 好，從現在起不用難字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I missed your name just now.
dialogue.zh: 我剛剛沒聽清楚你的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is Wu, I said it too soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz wu, aɪ sɛd ɪt tu sɔft./
dialogue.zh: 是吳，我剛才念得太輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two seconds between each line?
dialogue.zh: 每句中間停兩秒好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will count to two.
dialogue.zh: 可以，我數到二再繼續。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I hear a number there?
dialogue.zh: 我剛才好像聽到一個數字？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two, the pause I promised.
dialogue.zh: 有，是二，就是我答應停的秒數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you go at a slower speed?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju ɡoʊ ət ə ˈsloʊɚ spiːd?/
dialogue.zh: 你可以用慢一點的速度說嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I slow down, ask me anything.
dialogue.zh: 我放慢，你隨意問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say the first half again.
dialogue.zh: 前面那一半再說一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This half, or the one before?
dialogue.zh: 這一半，還是更前面那段？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your voice a notch lower?
dialogue.zh: 你的聲音再低一點好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like this, is that clear enough?
dialogue.zh: 這樣嗎，夠清楚了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I wrote down a wrong word.
dialogue.zh: 我記下一個錯字了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show me, we can fix it fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ mi, wi kæn fɪks ɪt fæst./
dialogue.zh: 給我看，我們很快就能改好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was that a question or a story?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌz ðæt ə ˈkwɛstʃən ɔr ə ˈstɔri?/
dialogue.zh: 那是在問問題，還是在說故事？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A story, and it has a name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈstɔri, ænd ɪt hæz ə neɪm./
dialogue.zh: 是故事，裡面還有一個名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you speak fast with everyone?
dialogue.zh: 你跟每一個人說話都這麼快嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only when I feel excited here.
dialogue.zh: 只有在這裡興奮的時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more time, with a pause.
dialogue.zh: 再說一次，中間停一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, this time listen for three.
dialogue.zh: 好，這次專心聽三個字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which word did I not get?
dialogue.zh: 我哪個字沒聽出來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The third one, it means a break.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə θɜrd wʌn, ɪt minz ə breɪk./
dialogue.zh: 第三個字，意思是休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I ask you to wait?
dialogue.zh: 我該請你等一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always, waiting is free here.
dialogue.zh: 隨時都可以，等是不用錢的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your last sentence ran away.
dialogue.zh: 你最後那句話跑太快了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, my brain spoke before me.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我的腦比我先開口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A pause in the middle there?
dialogue.zh: 說到一半可以暫停嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do, I will start clean.
dialogue.zh: 請打斷，我會重新乾淨地開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My face looks confused right now?
dialogue.zh: 我現在的臉看起來很困惑嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, so I made it short.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl, soʊ aɪ meɪd ɪt ʃɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 有一點，所以我把話說短。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Give me the slow version.
dialogue.zh: 給我慢一點的那個版本。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here it is, word by word.
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，一個字一個字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you change the ending word?
dialogue.zh: 你換掉了最後那個字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, night, not noon, say night.
dialogue.zh: 有，是晚上，不是中午，念晚上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Speak to me, not to the room.
dialogue.phonetic: /spik tu mi, nɑt tu ðə rum./
dialogue.zh: 對著我說，不要對著整個房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, I watched the door again.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我又一直看著門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I hear a whole line?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ hɪr ə hoʊl laɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 要怎樣才能聽懂整句子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Catch the first word, then rest.
dialogue.zh: 先抓住第一個字，剩下就鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You joined all the words together.
dialogue.zh: 你把所有字黏在一起了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: English runs words together, one more try.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ rʌnz wɜrdz təˈɡɛðɚ, wʌn mɔr traɪ./
dialogue.zh: 英文就會把字連起來，再試一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A simpler topic on that pile?
dialogue.zh: 那疊卡裡有更簡單的話題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, take the easy card pile.
dialogue.zh: 可以，拿那一疊簡單的卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saying slow is not rude here?
dialogue.zh: 在這裡要求慢說不算失禮吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, slow here means kind.
dialogue.zh: 不算，慢在這裡是善意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me try your sentence back.
dialogue.zh: 讓我試著把你的句子說回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, I will listen close.
dialogue.zh: 你說，我仔細聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I ask too many repeats?
dialogue.zh: 我會不會一直要求重複？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask more, nobody minds tonight.
dialogue.zh: 儘管問，今晚沒人會介意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That last word went too quick.
dialogue.zh: 最後那個字一下子就過去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Again, it means a small gift.
dialogue.zh: 再聽一次，它是指小禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Music off in this room now?
dialogue.zh: 這個房間現在沒有音樂嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, now you hear only us.
dialogue.zh: 關了，現在只聽得到我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please repeat that date one time.
dialogue.zh: 那個日期請你再說一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nineteen, it was a Tuesday night.
dialogue.zh: 十九號，那是週二的晚上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My pen caught none of that.
dialogue.zh: 我的筆一個字都沒記下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Copy my page, I wrote two lines.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑpi maɪ peɪdʒ, aɪ roʊt tu laɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 抄我那頁，我寫了兩行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Louder English helps you hear?
dialogue.zh: 英文大聲一點對你有幫助嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are fine, I speak too soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr faɪn, aɪ spik tu sɔft./
dialogue.zh: 你剛好，是我說得太輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say just the newest word.
dialogue.zh: 只說那個最新的字就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trade, it means a swap.
dialogue.zh: 交換，那是一個互換的意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: End tonight on a slow round?
dialogue.zh: 今晚最後一輪慢一點好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one minute with no clock.
dialogue.zh: 好，一分鐘不看時計。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I understand better when you wait.
dialogue.zh: 你一停下來我就比較聽得懂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I wait, you start next.
dialogue.zh: 那我等，下一段你先說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was I too silent there?
dialogue.zh: 我剛剛是不是太安靜了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I talked over you twice.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，是我打斷你兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show me one short form here?
dialogue.zh: 這裡示範一個縮寫好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am becomes I'm, try once.
dialogue.zh: 兩個字縮成一個，你試著唸一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do people here stop for slow talk?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ˈpipəl hɪr stɑp fɔr sloʊ tɔk?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡的人會配合放慢速度嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone does, that is the point.
dialogue.zh: 每個人都會，這就是重點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I lost the middle of it.
dialogue.zh: 中間那段我聽丟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The middle is about her sister.
dialogue.zh: 中間在講她姊姊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That small word, what does it ask?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt smɔl wɜrd, wʌt dʌz ɪt æsk?/
dialogue.zh: 那個小字是在問什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It asks the reason for a thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt æskz ðə ˈrizən fɔr ə θɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 它在問一件事情的理由。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You helped me hear that line.
dialogue.zh: 你剛剛幫我聽見那句話了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next time I will help again.
dialogue.zh: 下一輪我還會幫你聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Talking slow feels strange at first.
dialogue.zh: 一開始慢講感覺怪怪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but it works on day two.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, bʌt ɪt wɜrks ɑn deɪ tu./
dialogue.zh: 是，但第二天就有用了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I close my eyes to hear?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ kloʊz maɪ aɪz tu hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 我該閉著眼睛聽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it helps when the room is loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt hɛlps wɛn ðə rum ɪz laʊd./
dialogue.zh: 可以，房間吵的時候很有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did that answer my first question?
dialogue.zh: 那有回答我的第一個問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Partly, ask the rest again slowly.
dialogue.zh: 有一部分，剩下的請你慢慢再問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we sit in a quiet spot?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi sɪt ɪn ə ˈkwaɪət spɑt?/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以坐到安靜的地方嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the hall corner is calm.
dialogue.zh: 可以，大廳那個角落很靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time I will speak slower.
dialogue.zh: 下次我會講得再慢一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And I will wait for your words.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd aɪ wɪl weɪt fɔr jɔr wɜrdz./
dialogue.zh: 那我也會等你的字說完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which sound starts this card word?
dialogue.zh: 這張卡上的字是哪個音開始的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It starts soft, like a happy h.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stɑrts sɔft, laɪk ə ˈhæpi eɪtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 開頭很輕，像輕輕吐氣的那個音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say this whole word once for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ðɪs hoʊl wɜrd wʌns fɔr mi?/
dialogue.zh: 這個字整個唸一遍好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, listen and copy me.
dialogue.zh: 可以，聽著然後跟著我念。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many sounds are in it?
dialogue.zh: 這個字裡面有幾個音？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three small ones, try to hear them.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri smɔl wʌnz, traɪ tu hɪr ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 三個小音，你試著聽出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The first sound here, too hard?
dialogue.zh: 開頭那個音很難嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is just a quiet h.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ɪt ɪz dʒʌst ə ˈkwaɪət eɪtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 不難，只是一個輕輕的氣音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the last sound here?
dialogue.zh: 這個字最後一個音是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A light k, very short.
dialogue.zh: 一個很輕的『克』音，很短促。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which part gets the stress?
dialogue.zh: 這個字哪一段要加重音？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The middle, say it loud there.
dialogue.zh: 中間那段，那裡要唸大聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I read that word right?
dialogue.zh: 我那個字唸對了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close, the second part was flat.
dialogue.zh: 很接近了，第二段太平了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One silent letter in this word?
dialogue.zh: 這個字裡有個不發音的字母嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the last one hides here.
dialogue.zh: 有，最後那個字母不出聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Split it into two parts?
dialogue.zh: 把它切成兩段好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two halves, then glue them back.
dialogue.zh: 拆成兩段，再接回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is the first vowel?
dialogue.zh: 第一個母音要拉多長？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Long, hold it one beat more.
dialogue.zh: 很長，比平常多停一拍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say the whole line, I will copy.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ðə hoʊl laɪn, aɪ wɪl ˈkɑpi./
dialogue.zh: 整行唸一次，我會跟著念。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, match my rising tone.
dialogue.zh: 好，跟我的上揚語調一致。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this tag name have two syllables?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðɪs tæɡ neɪm hæv tu ˈsɪləbəlz?/
dialogue.zh: 名牌上這個名字有兩個音節嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, say it in two beats.
dialogue.zh: 有，用兩拍把它唸完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more try at this sound?
dialogue.zh: 這個音我再試一次好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that last sound is new.
dialogue.zh: 好，最後那個音你還在學。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did my mouth shape look wrong?
dialogue.zh: 我的嘴形是不是怪怪的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Round it more, then try again.
dialogue.zh: 再圓一點，然後重新試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does the small print say?
dialogue.zh: 卡下面那行小字寫什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It gives the word in Chinese.
dialogue.zh: 它給你這個字的中文意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it sound like our last word?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ɪt saʊnd laɪk ˈaʊr læst wɜrd?/
dialogue.zh: 這個字聽起來像我們剛才那個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A bit, but the start is new.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bɪt, bʌt ðə stɑrt ɪz nu./
dialogue.zh: 有一點，不過開頭不一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read the hard word to me.
dialogue.zh: 你先唸那個難的字給我聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You first, I will fix after.
dialogue.zh: 你先，之後我再幫你調整。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does the breath go here?
dialogue.zh: 這個音的氣要到哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push it from the middle sound.
dialogue.zh: 從中間那個音把氣推出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I saying it too flat?
dialogue.zh: 我是不是唸得太平了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift the end, it asks a thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪft ði ɛnd, ɪt æskz ə θɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 把句尾上揚，這句是在問問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A missing letter in this one?
dialogue.zh: 這個字少了一個字母嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one letter sleeps here.
dialogue.zh: 對，有一個字母在這裡睡著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stretch that first half longer?
dialogue.zh: 前半段拉長一點好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I will pull it long.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，我把它拉長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The ending short or long here?
dialogue.zh: 這裡的尾音是短還是長？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Short, do not pull it out.
dialogue.zh: 短的，不要把它拉出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you hear my broken word?
dialogue.zh: 你剛剛聽到我那個唸壞的詞了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I did, and it was lovely.
dialogue.zh: 聽到了，而且很可愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which card has the new word?
dialogue.zh: 哪一張卡上有新的字？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The blue one, third from the top.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə blu wʌn, θɜrd frʌm ðə tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 藍色那張，從上面數第三個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A recording from a native voice?
dialogue.zh: 有母語人士的錄音嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The host plays one on her phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hoʊst pleɪz wʌn ɑn hɚ foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 主持人會用手機撥一個給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Copy this word or just listen?
dialogue.zh: 這個字要跟唸還是先聽？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both, then say it back twice.
dialogue.zh: 兩個都要，然後回唸兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I start the second half?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ stɑrt ðə ˈsɛkənd hæf?/
dialogue.zh: 後半部我該從哪裡開始？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From the middle sound again.
dialogue.zh: 再從中間那個音開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this letter make two sounds?
dialogue.zh: 這個字母會發兩種音嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, here it takes the second.
dialogue.zh: 會，在這個字裡它是第二種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say it once like a name, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ɪt wʌns laɪk ə neɪm, pliz./
dialogue.zh: 請像念人名那樣說一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like this, flat and small.
dialogue.zh: 像這樣，平平的、小小的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My stress sat in the wrong place.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ strɛs sæt ɪn ðə rɔŋ pleɪs./
dialogue.zh: 我的重音落在錯的地方了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move it left and try once.
dialogue.zh: 往左移一格，再試一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is one sound longer than the rest?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz wʌn saʊnd ˈlɔŋɡɚ ðæn ðə rɛst?/
dialogue.zh: 有一個音比別的音長嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the first one is longest.
dialogue.zh: 有，第一個最長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mark it on my word card?
dialogue.zh: 在我的字卡上做記號好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a small dot will help.
dialogue.zh: 可以，點一個小點就有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What rhymes with that last sound?
dialogue.zh: 什麼字跟最後那個音押韻？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Moon, it shares the same tail.
dialogue.zh: 月亮那個字，尾巴一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I copy the wrong letter?
dialogue.zh: 我抄錯字母了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the shape is just small.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，只是字形寫得小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do Chinese mouths say it?
dialogue.zh: 中文的嘴會怎麼說這個音？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We add a light ending there.
dialogue.zh: 我們在那裡加一個輕的尾音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The whole card line, one time?
dialogue.zh: 整行字卡內容唸一次好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but stop at the comma.
dialogue.zh: 可以，不過逗號那裡要停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the middle sound a problem?
dialogue.zh: 中間那個音對你來說很為難嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only mine, yours came out clean.
dialogue.zh: 為難的是我，你唸得很乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tone or the stress first?
dialogue.zh: 先問聲調還是先問重音？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stress, the tone comes after that.
dialogue.zh: 先重音，語調會自己跟上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which word on this card is hardest?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ wɜrd ɑn ðɪs kɑrd ɪz ˈhɑrdəst?/
dialogue.zh: 這張卡上最難唸的是哪個字？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The last one, it has four sounds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læst wʌn, ɪt hæz fɔr saʊndz./
dialogue.zh: 最後那個，它有四個音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten slow drills on one word?
dialogue.zh: 一個字慢慢練十次好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, five slow and five fast.
dialogue.zh: 好，五次慢、五次快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I adding a sound myself?
dialogue.zh: 我是不是自己多加了一個音？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are, drop the extra tail.
dialogue.zh: 是，把多出來的尾音拿掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That word ends on a hard stop?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wɜrd ɛndz ɑn ə hɑrd stɑp?/
dialogue.zh: 那個字結尾是突然停住嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, cut it short, no hum.
dialogue.zh: 對，切短，不要哼出聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read it again without the card.
dialogue.zh: 不要看卡再唸一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, I said it from memory.
dialogue.zh: 好了，我是靠記憶說出來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All these words, or only two?
dialogue.zh: 這些字全問，還是只挑兩個？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only two, then we keep talking.
dialogue.zh: 只能問兩個，然後繼續聊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this sound in my language?
dialogue.zh: 我的語言裡有這個音嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, so your mouth needs practice.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，所以你的嘴要練習。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the host teach this sound?
dialogue.zh: 這個音是主持人教的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Last week, we drilled it twice.
dialogue.zh: 上週教的，我們練了兩輪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whisper this one before I say it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪspɚ ðɪs wʌn bɪˈfɔr aɪ seɪ ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 這個字我先小聲試一次好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, then say it out loud.
dialogue.zh: 可以，然後再大聲說一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which half of the word is quiet?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ hæf əv ðə wɜrd ɪz ˈkwaɪət?/
dialogue.zh: 這個字哪一半是輕輕的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tail, almost nothing there.
dialogue.zh: 尾巴那半，幾乎沒有力氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I hear your first try?
dialogue.zh: 我可以先聽你唸一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This, now you copy the length.
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，你照它的長短唸一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The card shows how to say it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑrd ʃoʊz haʊ tə seɪ ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 卡上有標怎麼唸嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, that is why we ask here.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðæt ɪz waɪ wi æsk hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，所以我們才要在這裡問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The card game comes next?
dialogue.zh: 接下來玩字卡遊戲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the host shuffles every deck.
dialogue.zh: 對，主持人把每一副牌都洗過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many cards go face down?
dialogue.zh: 幾張卡要正面朝下？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty, ten pairs on the cloth.
dialogue.zh: 二十張，桌布上放十對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Word cards meet picture cards here?
dialogue.zh: 這裡是文字卡配圖卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, English cards meet Chinese cards.
dialogue.zh: 不是，是英文卡配中文卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who flips first in this round?
dialogue.zh: 這一輪誰先翻卡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You, your tag number is small.
dialogue.zh: 你，你名牌上的號碼比較小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Move the pile to my side?
dialogue.zh: 把那疊卡移到我這邊好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, the pile is on your side.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr, ðə paɪl ɪz ɑn jɔr saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 給，卡堆現在放在你那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do I do after one pair?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt du aɪ du ˈæftɚ wʌn pɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 配成一對之後我還要幹嘛？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flip two more, keep looking.
dialogue.zh: 再翻兩張，繼續找。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Peeking at the edge, allowed?
dialogue.zh: 偷看卡的邊邊可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, cover the card edges.
dialogue.zh: 不行，把卡的邊緣蓋好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Points counted out loud here?
dialogue.zh: 這裡的分數要唸出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one point for each match.
dialogue.zh: 對，每配成一對就一分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who keeps score on the board?
dialogue.zh: 誰在白板上記分？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The host, she writes fast.
dialogue.zh: 主持人，她寫得很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This card matches my last one.
dialogue.zh: 這張跟我剛才那張配得起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, that is your third pair.
dialogue.zh: 好，這是你的第三對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take turns flipping the cards?
dialogue.zh: 翻卡是輪流來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one flip, then I go.
dialogue.zh: 對，翻一次就換我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do we win this game?
dialogue.zh: 這個遊戲要怎麼獲勝？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most pairs when the timer ends.
dialogue.zh: 計時結束時配對最多的人贏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I hold my matched cards?
dialogue.zh: 我配好的卡可以一直拿著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, keep them in a stack.
dialogue.zh: 可以，把它們疊成一堆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This deck stays on one table?
dialogue.zh: 這副卡只用在一桌嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, do not share across tables.
dialogue.zh: 對，不可以跨桌共用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two cards show the same animal.
dialogue.zh: 有兩張卡畫著同一種動物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flip them, that is a match.
dialogue.zh: 把它們翻開，那是一對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does the timer run?
dialogue.zh: 計時器跑多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five minutes, then we count pairs.
dialogue.zh: 五分鐘，然後開始數配對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Reshuffle cards at the break?
dialogue.zh: 休息時會重新洗牌嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the host takes all cards back.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə hoʊst teɪks ɔl kɑrdz bæk./
dialogue.zh: 會，主持人把所有卡收回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I missed that match by one card.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ mɪst ðæt mætʃ baɪ wʌn kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 我差一張卡就配成那對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Again, the same deck, new order.
dialogue.zh: 再來一次，同一副牌，新的順序。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hard words out of this game?
dialogue.zh: 難字可以不用玩嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, every card joins play.
dialogue.zh: 不行，每張卡都要上桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if two hands flip one card?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf tu hændz flɪp wʌn kɑrd?/
dialogue.zh: 如果兩個人同時翻同一張怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then that pair goes back down.
dialogue.zh: 那這一對就重新蓋回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these the travel cards?
dialogue.zh: 這些是旅遊主題的卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, next week uses this deck.
dialogue.zh: 對，下週那場要用這副。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The word out loud on each flip?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɜrd aʊt laʊd ɑn itʃ flɪp?/
dialogue.zh: 每次翻開都要唸出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always, the mouth helps memory.
dialogue.zh: 一定要唸，嘴巴能幫忙記。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your pile has five left.
dialogue.zh: 你那一疊還剩五張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yours has four, so hurry up.
dialogue.zh: 我這一疊四張，所以你快一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is one card left face down?
dialogue.zh: 還有一張卡蓋著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, its pair hides near you.
dialogue.zh: 對，跟它配對那張就在你旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A fresh deck from that box?
dialogue.zh: 可以從那盒拿一副新的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the box sits on that chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə bɑks sɪts ɑn ðæt tʃɛr./
dialogue.zh: 可以，裝牌的盒子在那張椅子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pairs win this game together?
dialogue.zh: 這遊戲是兩組一起贏嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two pairs win the round.
dialogue.zh: 對，湊到兩對就拿下這一輪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who taught us this card game?
dialogue.zh: 這個字卡遊戲是誰教我們的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A guest last month, we loved it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɡɛst læst mʌnθ, wi lʌvd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 上個月一位來賓教的，我們很愛玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need a slow round of cards.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid ə sloʊ raʊnd əv kɑrdz./
dialogue.zh: 我需要一輪慢一點的字卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it, the timer can wait.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢玩，計時器可以等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we mix the two decks?
dialogue.zh: 我們要把兩副牌混在一起嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, easy ones stay alone.
dialogue.zh: 不用，簡單的牌自己一疊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I hear the bell ring?
dialogue.zh: 我剛剛聽到鐘聲了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the game round just ended.
dialogue.zh: 有，遊戲那一輪剛好結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We tied at four pairs.
dialogue.zh: 我們打成平手，各四對。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the host calls one more round.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə hoʊst kɔlz wʌn mɔr raʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 所以主持人再宣佈一輪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next round, a win for me?
dialogue.zh: 下一輪讓我贏一次好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, my memory is worse.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，我記性沒你好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cards back on the table tonight?
dialogue.zh: 卡今晚還在桌上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, they sleep in the box.
dialogue.zh: 不了，它們要在盒子裡睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The word card is missing here.
dialogue.zh: 這裡少了一張字卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The host has a spare deck.
dialogue.zh: 主持人還有一副備用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four players on this one table?
dialogue.zh: 這一桌可以四個人玩嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two decks, two each side.
dialogue.zh: 可以，兩副牌，兩邊各兩個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flip the card with the food word.
dialogue.phonetic: /flɪp ðə kɑrd wɪð ðə fud wɜrd./
dialogue.zh: 翻開那張寫食物的卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This, it matches a chopstick card.
dialogue.zh: 這張，它跟筷子那張成一對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read both matched cards aloud?
dialogue.zh: 配成的兩張都要大聲讀嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I read mine, you read yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, aɪ rid maɪn, ju rid jɔrz./
dialogue.zh: 好，我讀我的，你讀你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My pair is on the top row.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ pɛr ɪz ɑn ðə tɑp roʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我要配的那對在最上面一排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, flip them before my turn.
dialogue.zh: 好，趁輪到我之前翻掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is losing fine in this game?
dialogue.zh: 這個遊戲輸了也沒關係嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, words are the prize.
dialogue.zh: 當然，字才是獎勵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many cards did you get?
dialogue.zh: 你拿到了幾張卡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four pairs, how about you?
dialogue.zh: 四對，你呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One card home as homework?
dialogue.zh: 帶一張卡回家當功課嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, take the word you liked.
dialogue.zh: 可以，拿你喜歡的那個字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Table cleared before the next round?
dialogue.zh: 下一輪前先把桌子收乾淨嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, all cards go back sorted.
dialogue.zh: 對，所有的卡照順序收回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That move was quick and smart.
dialogue.zh: 你那一步又快又聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I saw it the moment you flipped.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɔ ɪt ðə ˈmoʊmənt ju flɪpt./
dialogue.zh: 你翻開那瞬間我就看見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal me a fresh card, please.
dialogue.zh: 請給我發一張新卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, hide it from the table.
dialogue.zh: 給，別讓桌上那邊看到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more round, then tea time.
dialogue.zh: 再來一輪，然後是喝茶時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the last round needs speed.
dialogue.zh: 好，最後那一輪要快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who won the whole card game?
dialogue.zh: 整場字卡遊戲誰贏了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You did, seven pairs to five.
dialogue.zh: 是你，七對比五對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we play again next week?
dialogue.zh: 下週我們還能再玩這個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it stays on the plan.
dialogue.zh: 能，它一直在活動流程裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I mixed my pile with yours.
dialogue.zh: 我把我的那疊跟你混到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, we sort it together.
dialogue.zh: 沒事，我們一起分好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the small cards for new words?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə smɔl kɑrdz fɔr nu wɜrdz?/
dialogue.zh: 小卡是給新字的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, big cards hold names.
dialogue.zh: 對，大卡上面是人名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we clap when someone wins?
dialogue.zh: 有人贏的時候我們要拍手嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, three claps, then we reset.
dialogue.zh: 對，拍三下，然後重新擺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phone numbers traded tonight?
dialogue.zh: 今晚交換電話號碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, write yours on my paper.
dialogue.zh: 可以，把你的寫在我這張紙上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I put my digits?
dialogue.zh: 我的數字該寫在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back of the tag, big and clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk əv ðə tæɡ, bɪɡ ænd klɪr./
dialogue.zh: 名牌背面，寫大、寫清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I say my number slow?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ seɪ maɪ ˈnʌmbɚ sloʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我的號碼要怎麼慢慢念？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One at a time, I will write.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn æt ə taɪm, aɪ wɪl raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 一個一個報，我會寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me save you as Kevin.
dialogue.zh: 我把你存成凱文。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, put the word corner there.
dialogue.zh: 好，後面加註英語角這幾個字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A group chat for this corner?
dialogue.zh: 這個英語角有群組聊天嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, forty people chat there.
dialogue.zh: 有，四十個人在那裡聊天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Texts in English, or Chinese too?
dialogue.zh: 傳訊用英文，還是也可以用中文？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Either works, Chinese is welcome too.
dialogue.zh: 哪一種都行，中文也歡迎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your name, what does it mean?
dialogue.zh: 你的名字是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It means a small bright light.
dialogue.zh: 它的意思是小小的亮光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you call me or write?
dialogue.zh: 你會打電話給我還是寫給我？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write, my ears are worse at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, maɪ ɪrz ɑr wɜrs æt naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 寫就好，我晚上耳朵比較差。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My number changed last month.
dialogue.zh: 我的號碼上個月換過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then cross out the old one.
dialogue.zh: 那我把舊的那個劃掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My cousin on this contact list?
dialogue.zh: 我表妹可以加進這份名單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only guests, the list is private.
dialogue.zh: 只能加來過英語角的人，這份名單是私下的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Notebooks swapped along with numbers?
dialogue.zh: 筆記本也跟號碼一起交換嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the word list is inside mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə wɜrd lɪst ɪz ɪnˈsaɪd maɪn./
dialogue.zh: 會，我那本裡面有單字清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say your number again, please.
dialogue.zh: 你的號碼請再說一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slowly this time, then check mine.
dialogue.zh: 這次說慢一點，然後幫我檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which letter starts your street?
dialogue.zh: 你住的那條街開頭是哪個字母？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The letter after g, come find it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlɛtɚ ˈæftər dʒi, kʌm faɪnd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 是 g 後面那個字母，來找看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Texts answered the same day?
dialogue.zh: 訊息當天就會回嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only after work, around nine.
dialogue.zh: 只有下班後，大概九點左右。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will message you on Friday.
dialogue.zh: 我週五傳訊息給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, Friday is the best day.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，週五最方便。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Play your voice note for me?
dialogue.zh: 可以聽你的語音訊息嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, press play and listen once.
dialogue.zh: 可以，按播放聽一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone dies by noon.
dialogue.zh: 我的手機到中午就沒電了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then keep my number on paper.
dialogue.zh: 那就把我的號碼寫在紙上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Emails on that sign sheet too?
dialogue.zh: 那張簽到表也留電子郵件嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some do, the sheet has space.
dialogue.zh: 有人會，那張表還有位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add me before you leave tonight.
dialogue.zh: 你今晚走之前先把我加進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, now send me one word.
dialogue.zh: 加好了，現在傳一個字給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is your corner nickname?
dialogue.zh: 你在英語角的綽號是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mouse, from a card game win.
dialogue.zh: 小老鼠，因為贏了一局字卡遊戲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A hard word texted to you?
dialogue.zh: 可以傳難字向你問嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will fix the spelling.
dialogue.zh: 可以，我幫你改拼寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My work number, or just the home one?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ wɜrk ˈnʌmbɚ, ɔr dʒʌst ðə hoʊm wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 給工作電話，還是只給家裡的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just the home one, if it is okay.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ðə hoʊm wʌn, ɪf ɪt ɪz oʊˈkeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 只留家裡那支，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the group list long now?
dialogue.zh: 群組名單現在很長了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty now, it grows each week.
dialogue.zh: 四十個人了，每週都在增加。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you save my name right?
dialogue.zh: 我的名字你存對了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close, one letter was missing.
dialogue.zh: 很接近，少了一個字母。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us test one text tonight.
dialogue.zh: 我們今晚先試傳一則訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send it, I will answer slow.
dialogue.zh: 你傳，我會慢慢回。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Speaking partners, nothing more formal?
dialogue.zh: 只是練習夥伴，不用太正式吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that is a good rule.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，這是一條好規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I forgot to write your number.
dialogue.zh: 我忘了寫你的號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look at my tag, I added it.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt maɪ tæɡ, aɪ ˈædəd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 看我的名牌背面，我補寫上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Old name tags kept or tossed?
dialogue.zh: 舊名牌是留著還是丟掉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kept, they show my corner weeks.
dialogue.zh: 留著，它們記著我來的週數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did the host post the list?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dɪd ðə hoʊst poʊst ðə lɪst?/
dialogue.zh: 主持人把名單貼在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the door, under the sign.
dialogue.zh: 在門上，通告單下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read my digits back to me?
dialogue.zh: 把我的號碼唸回來確認好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will check each digit.
dialogue.zh: 可以，我一個數字一個數字對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Send me a photo of the card.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnd mi ə ˈfoʊtoʊ əv ðə kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 把那張卡拍一張傳給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I will take one at eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, aɪ wɪl teɪk wʌn ət eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 好啊，八點時我拍一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Meeting outside the corner soon?
dialogue.zh: 近期會在英語角外面聚會嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only in groups, tea after.
dialogue.zh: 只約團體，結束後一起喝茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a weekend call too much?
dialogue.zh: 週末打電話會不會太打擾？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, Sunday mornings are calm.
dialogue.zh: 不會，週日上午很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You have my wrong digits.
dialogue.zh: 你手上那組數字是舊的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show me, I will fix them now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ mi, aɪ wɪl fɪks ðɛm naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 給我看，我現在就改。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The host hands out phone numbers?
dialogue.zh: 主持會發大家的電話嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She gives none, we ask each other.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɡɪvz nʌn, wi æsk itʃ ˈʌðɚ./
dialogue.zh: 她都不給，我們自己互相問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We swapped tags by mistake.
dialogue.zh: 我們拿錯彼此的名牌了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then read mine back to me.
dialogue.zh: 那把我那張的數字唸給我聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The old group chat, delete it?
dialogue.zh: 舊的群組聊天要刪掉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it, your words are there.
dialogue.zh: 留著，你練過的字都在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your number is easy to keep.
dialogue.zh: 你的號碼很好記。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine was hard, until tonight.
dialogue.zh: 我以前那組很難記，直到今晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Text me if I miss the game.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst mi ɪf aɪ mɪs ðə ɡeɪm./
dialogue.zh: 如果我錯過了遊戲，傳訊息給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will, on the Tuesday before.
dialogue.zh: 會啊，在之前那個週二就提醒你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us practice one short line.
dialogue.zh: 我們先練一個短句子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your line first, my ears are ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr laɪn fɜrst, maɪ ɪrz ɑr ˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 你先說，我的耳朵準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: English written at home, often?
dialogue.zh: 在家裡常常寫英文嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice a week, after dinner.
dialogue.zh: 一週兩次，吃完晚飯之後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
