dialogue.text: I will send you a song.
dialogue.zh: 我會傳一首歌給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sing it next time, slowly.
dialogue.zh: 下次慢慢唱給我聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I add my tag photo?
dialogue.zh: 我的頭像可以用名牌照片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, take one at the wall.
dialogue.zh: 可以，在展示牆那邊拍一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who gave me this phone number?
dialogue.zh: 這組電話號碼是誰給我的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I did, you asked for it.
dialogue.zh: 是我給的，你開口問我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the number list full now?
dialogue.zh: 號碼單現在寫滿了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, everyone wrote except Ann.
dialogue.zh: 滿了，除了安大家都寫了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks before leaving, is that it?
dialogue.zh: 離開前道謝，就這樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one new word on the way out.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wʌn nu wɜrd ɑn ðə weɪ aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 對，離開前再講一個新字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I find you by your tag?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ faɪnd ju baɪ jɔr tæɡ?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以照名牌找到你嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Green tag, I stand near cards.
dialogue.zh: 綠色名牌，我通常站在字卡旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next week we need fresh tags.
dialogue.zh: 下週我們需要新的名牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the old box is empty.
dialogue.zh: 對，那個舊盒子已經空了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I write my city name too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ raɪt maɪ ˈsɪti neɪm tu?/
dialogue.zh: 我要把城市名稱也寫上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it helps the group chat.
dialogue.zh: 有，群組裡這樣比較好認。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was my first trade tonight.
dialogue.zh: 這是我今晚第一次交換號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, text me first now.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，現在換你先傳給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is next week's topic card?
dialogue.zh: 下週的話題卡是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Travel, it is the theme.
dialogue.zh: 旅遊，下週就是這個主題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Guests vote on themes here?
dialogue.zh: 在這裡大家會投票選主題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, travel won by two votes.
dialogue.zh: 會，旅遊以兩票勝出。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I learn travel words tonight?
dialogue.zh: 我今晚該先背旅遊的字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, ten words will carry you.
dialogue.zh: 對，十個字就夠你撐完整場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who brings the travel card deck?
dialogue.zh: 誰要帶旅遊那副字卡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The host, it lives in the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hoʊst, ɪt lɪvz ɪn ðə bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 主持人，那副牌一直住在盒子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One trip photo in my hand?
dialogue.zh: 我可以帶一張旅行照片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, show it to your partner.
dialogue.zh: 可以，給你的搭檔看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Trains or beaches for next talk?
dialogue.zh: 下次聊火車還是海灘？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both, each pair picks one side.
dialogue.zh: 都可以，每一組自己挑一邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same room next Tuesday evening?
dialogue.zh: 下週二還是在同一間教室？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same room, same hour, same tea.
dialogue.zh: 同一間、同一時間、同一種茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the people from last week come?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə ˈpipəl frʌm læst wik kʌm?/
dialogue.zh: 上週來那些人都會來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most do, I said yes already.
dialogue.zh: 多數會，我已經答應了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A new white tag next week?
dialogue.zh: 下週要換新的白色名牌嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, take a white one, travel week.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, teɪk ə waɪt wʌn, ˈtrævəl wik./
dialogue.zh: 對，旅遊那週拿白色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What travel question starts the night?
dialogue.zh: 哪個旅遊問題會用來開場？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where did you sleep last summer?
dialogue.zh: 去年夏天你住在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we speak only English then?
dialogue.zh: 到時候我們只說英文嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half then, same rule as tonight.
dialogue.zh: 只說一半，規矩跟今晚一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pick your own partner next week?
dialogue.zh: 下週可以自己挑夥伴嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try, the bell may split you.
dialogue.zh: 試試看，鐘聲可能還是會把你們拆開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I plan a short answer?
dialogue.zh: 我該先準備一個短答覆嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, three lines fit one round.
dialogue.zh: 對，三句話剛好講完一輪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The corner is going on a trip?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɔrnɚ ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ ɑn ə trɪp?/
dialogue.zh: 英語角要舉辦旅行嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a park walk in June.
dialogue.zh: 會，六月去公園走一走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Payment for the park walk?
dialogue.zh: 公園散步要收費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing, bring water and shoes.
dialogue.zh: 不用錢，自備水和鞋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many weeks should I come?
dialogue.zh: 我應該連續來幾週？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four, then you will hear fine.
dialogue.zh: 四週，之後聽就沒問題了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you teach me map words?
dialogue.zh: 你會教我的地圖用語嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I get lost with maps.
dialogue.zh: 會，我自己看地圖也會迷路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Start next week with a travel game?
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrt nɛkst wik wɪð ə ˈtrævəl ɡeɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 下週先用旅行遊戲開場嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the cards are packed already.
dialogue.zh: 可以，那些卡已經收好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write my trip in a short note?
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt maɪ trɪp ɪn ə ʃɔrt noʊt?/
dialogue.zh: 把我的旅行寫成小筆記嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, bring it and read aloud.
dialogue.zh: 好，帶來當場念給大家聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who needs a partner next week?
dialogue.zh: 下週誰還缺一個搭檔？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two late guests, ask at the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu leɪt ɡɛsts, æsk æt ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 兩個遲到的來賓，在門口問一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is travel hard to talk about?
dialogue.zh: 旅遊這個話題很難聊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, food and bed are easy.
dialogue.zh: 不難，吃跟住都很好講。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you go anywhere last year?
dialogue.zh: 你去年去過什麼地方嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A mountain town, cold but clear.
dialogue.zh: 一個山中小鎮，冷但空氣很清。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same table next Tuesday night?
dialogue.zh: 下週二晚上還在同一桌嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same floor, new pair, new seats.
dialogue.zh: 同樣樓層，新搭檔、新座位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I bring my phrase book?
dialogue.zh: 我要把那本短句書帶來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the corner loves small books.
dialogue.zh: 對，英語角最喜歡小本書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask Linda for travel cards?
dialogue.zh: 可以請主持人給旅行字卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She sends them the day before.
dialogue.zh: 她會在前一天傳給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time should I arrive next week?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt taɪm ʃʊd aɪ əˈraɪv nɛkst wik?/
dialogue.zh: 下週我幾點到比較好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten minutes early, we sign tags.
dialogue.zh: 早十分鐘，我們要登記名牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I still take the blue tag?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ stɪl teɪk ðə blu tæɡ?/
dialogue.zh: 我還是拿藍色名牌嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, blue means English first.
dialogue.zh: 對，藍色代表英文先講。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the timer table stay?
dialogue.zh: 放計時器那張桌還會在嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, games come after the pairs.
dialogue.zh: 在，遊戲排在配對之後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A dream country on your list?
dialogue.zh: 你的清單上有夢想國家嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, mine is a hot island.
dialogue.zh: 有，我想去一座炎熱的島。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: New faces at the corner next week?
dialogue.phonetic: /nu ˈfeɪsəz æt ðə ˈkɔrnɚ nɛkst wik?/
dialogue.zh: 下週英語角有新面孔嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four, a class from the school.
dialogue.zh: 四個，是學校的一個班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I learn the word for trip?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ lɜrn ðə wɜrd fɔr trɪp?/
dialogue.zh: 我要先把旅行那個字背起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You said it tonight, well done.
dialogue.zh: 你今晚已經說過一次了，很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the travel deck big?
dialogue.zh: 那副旅遊牌很多張嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty cards, all with places.
dialogue.zh: 四十張，每張都是一個地名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hotel words tonight, or next week?
dialogue.zh: 飯店用語今晚講，還是下週？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next week, one night is short.
dialogue.zh: 下週吧，一晚的時間不夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My cousin at the door next week?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈkʌzən æt ðə dɔr nɛkst wik?/
dialogue.zh: 下週我表妹會來門口嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring her, tags will wait.
dialogue.zh: 帶她來，名牌會等你們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you text me the room number?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ju tɛkst mi ðə rum ˈnʌmbɚ?/
dialogue.zh: 你會傳訊息告訴我房間號碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, plus the bell time too.
dialogue.zh: 會，連敲鐘的時間一起給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last game before the bell?
dialogue.zh: 鐘響前還有一局遊戲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, cards for five minutes.
dialogue.zh: 會，字卡玩五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is next week my fifth night?
dialogue.zh: 下週是我來的第五晚了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, your third, keep going.
dialogue.zh: 不是，第三晚，繼續來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I ask my partner a question?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ æsk maɪ ˈpɑrtənɚ ə ˈkwɛstʃən?/
dialogue.zh: 我該問搭檔一個問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the card lists three good ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə kɑrd lɪsts θri ɡʊd wʌnz./
dialogue.zh: 對，卡上列了三個好問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hosts eat together here, yes?
dialogue.zh: 主持們都在這裡一起吃飯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tea after the last bell.
dialogue.zh: 會，最後一次鐘響後一起喝茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stay to help sort the cards?
dialogue.zh: 留下來幫忙分揀字卡好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the box needs one helper.
dialogue.zh: 可以，那個盒子正缺一個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should I say at the door?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ʃʊd aɪ seɪ æt ðə dɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 進門時我該說什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just say your name and sit.
dialogue.zh: 只要報名字，然後坐下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you save a chair for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ju seɪv ə tʃɛr fɔr mi?/
dialogue.zh: 你會幫我先留一張椅子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I do that each week.
dialogue.zh: 當然，我每週都會先留位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to book the travel night?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu bʊk ðə ˈtrævəl naɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 旅遊那一晚需要報名嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never, walk in as always.
dialogue.zh: 不用，跟平常直接走進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A promise for next Tuesday then?
dialogue.zh: 那我們下週二見，說定了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, next Tuesday, same door.
dialogue.zh: 可以，下週二，同樣的門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I get much tonight?
dialogue.zh: 我今晚收穫多嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You got thirty words, I did too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɡɑt ˈθɜrti wɜrdz, aɪ dɪd tu./
dialogue.zh: 你帶走三十個字，我也是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was the fast talk my fault?
dialogue.zh: 剛才講太快是我的錯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we both went too quick.
dialogue.zh: 不是，是我們兩個都衝太快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I come back in June?
dialogue.zh: 六月我還能回來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The corner rests that whole week.
dialogue.zh: 那一整週英語角放假。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I keep my travel card?
dialogue.zh: 我那張旅遊卡可以留著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, take it and study it.
dialogue.zh: 可以，帶回去自己複習。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I say goodbye tonight?
dialogue.zh: 今晚我要在哪裡道別？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At the tag box, with your cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt ðə tæɡ bɑks, wɪð jɔr kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 在名牌箱那邊，帶著你的杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you at the corner next week?
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju æt ðə ˈkɔrnɚ nɛkst wik?/
dialogue.zh: 下週英語角見，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, bring your trip story too.
dialogue.zh: 好，把你的旅行故事也帶來。
